mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decreases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a late-cycle economy with monetary tightening and labor market strength, preceding market corrections that yield negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * UNRATE change) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns are not observed when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market expansion (HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 500000) reflects robust consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 500000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger manufacturing output and economic supply, correlating with improved corporate profitability and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 signals weakening consumer demand for housing, preceding economic slowdowns that result in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1500 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate supply-driven expansion under monetary tightening, leading to rising interest costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (INDPRO change * FEDFUNDS change) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns are not observed when INDPRO and FEDFUNDS both rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong industrial expansion (INDPRO > 110), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 110 over a 3-year rolling window.
